scope: Super Soul 003 verification and validator status reconciliation
source_policy: Canonical source-of-truth remains authoritative for identity, acquisition, and canonical magnitude. Independent sources are corroboration and do not override canonical values.
acquisition: TP Medal Shop / STP Medal Shop
evidence: Current Super Soul catalogue lists an always-active -100% Kamehameha damage effect.
Current Kamehameha documentation states the soul nullifies Kamehameha-based damage.
Independent GameFAQs discussion documents the intended behavior as nullifying Kamehameha damage across Kamehameha variants.
decision: Promoted super-soul-003 from verified_secondary to verified without changing the canonical magnitude.
validator_reconciliation: The canonical layer contained documented verified_secondary records while the validator allowed only indexed, partially_verified, and verified. The validator now accepts verified_secondary rather than treating existing repository records as invalid.
unresolved_boundary: No undocumented frame/tick behavior, hidden exceptions, drop probability, or variant-specific implementation rule was promoted to canonical truth.
